AngelDevil.reducedJourney_allowed.theorem_title: Claim 2.6: allowed journeys remain allowed after reduction
AngelDevil.reducedJourney_allowed.formal_statement:
theorem AngelDevil.reducedJourney_allowed (p : Nat) (D : DevilStrategy) (h : List Point)
    (ha : Allowed p (niceReduction p D) h) : Allowed p D (reducedJourney p h)  := by sorry
AngelDevil.reducedJourney_allowed.natural_language_statement: For every nonnegative integer power, every Devil strategy and every finite journey allowed against its Nice transformation, the reduced journey is allowed against the original Devil. Allowedness includes both bounded jumps and avoidance of all earlier Devil selections. The statement also covers power zero.
AngelDevil.reducedJourney_allowed.source: Andras Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins, CPC 16 (2007), 363-374; https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303; author manuscript internal pagination. Claim 2.6, p. 3.

AngelDevil.confinement_to_nice.theorem_title: Theorem 2.4: transfer confinement to a Nice Devil
AngelDevil.confinement_to_nice.formal_statement:
theorem AngelDevil.confinement_to_nice (p N : Nat) (D : DevilStrategy)
    (hc : ∀ A n, (∀ m, m < n →
      Jump p (current (play A D m)) (current (play A D (m+1))) ∧
      some (current (play A D (m+1))) ∉ (play A D (m+1)).burned) →
      InBox N (current (play A D n))) : NiceCanConfine p N  := by sorry
AngelDevil.confinement_to_nice.natural_language_statement: Let p and N be nonnegative integers. If a Devil strategy keeps every safe finite play of the power-p Angel inside the box of radius N, then some Nice Devil does the same. The assumption ranges over every Angel strategy and every finite time, requiring safety only up to that time. This formalization includes the degenerate cases p = 0 and N = 0 in addition to the positive parameters in the paper.
AngelDevil.confinement_to_nice.source: Andras Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins, CPC 16 (2007), 363-374; https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303; author manuscript internal pagination. Theorem 2.4, pp. 2-3, with harmless zero-parameter extension.

AngelDevil.uniform_confinement.theorem_title: Claim 2.1 and determinacy: a uniform confinement box
AngelDevil.uniform_confinement.formal_statement:
theorem AngelDevil.uniform_confinement (p : Nat) (hp : 0 < p)
    (h : ¬ AngelWins p) : ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ ∃ D : DevilStrategy,
    ∀ A n, (∀ m, m < n →
      Jump p (current (play A D m)) (current (play A D (m+1))) ∧
      some (current (play A D (m+1))) ∉ (play A D (m+1)).burned) →
      InBox N (current (play A D n)) := by sorry
AngelDevil.uniform_confinement.natural_language_statement: For each positive integer power, if no single Angel strategy survives against every Devil, there is a positive integer radius and one Devil strategy such that every safe finite play remains inside that box. The radius and Devil are chosen before the Angel strategy and play length. This target includes the introductory determinacy observation as well as Claim 2.1; neither is assumed as an extra hypothesis.
AngelDevil.uniform_confinement.source: Andras Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins, CPC 16 (2007), 363-374; https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303; author manuscript internal pagination. Claim 2.1, p. 2, and the introductory determinacy observation, p. 1.
